findings.title: Refused hospitality is mirrored by wall support
findings.claim: The town's refusal of hospitality and the support given to the leaning wall form a bounded inversion: communal welcome withheld from travelers is enacted materially for the wall.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 18:77:11:1 has supplied leaning and hospitality branches. The refused-hosting relation at 18:77:9:2 meets the wall's impending collapse at 18:77:17:1, while wider hospitality records independently sharpen the contrast and return the reading through the same focus act.
findings.reader_payoff: The repair no longer appears as an isolated technical favor; it reveals which kind of load-bearing response the town withheld from the travelers.
findings.containment: The wall is not literally a guest, and the wider hospitality passages are contextual resonance rather than proof of a new surface translation. No other ض ي ف branch is activated.

epistemic.reason: The focus publication is trusted and anchored, while the represented HFT synthesis is legacy-unbound; the wider targets supply contextual parallels without target morphology.

findings.title: Hospitality is deferred toward absent dependents
findings.claim: The unpaid wall repair can be read as hospitality deferred from the refusing town toward absent orphan beneficiaries, preserving the town's failure while redirecting the benefit.
findings.mechanism: The focus hospitality carrier at 18:77:11:1 is set against the refusal at 18:77:9:2 and the wall's collapse at 18:77:17:1. The 18:82 disclosure and the supplied orphan-protection passages independently return through that relation, turning immediate exchange into delayed care.
findings.reader_payoff: The wall work becomes intelligible as care delivered to people who are not present, so the refusal scene gains an intergenerational beneficiary without becoming a service to the town.
findings.containment: This is an analogical hospitality reading grounded by the later orphan explanation and wider protection contexts. It does not claim that the wall is a guest or that all orphan-law passages describe the scene directly.

epistemic.reason: Both supplied supports are legacy-unbound reader walks; the focus carrier is registered, but the deferred-hosting relation is an attributed contextual synthesis.

findings.title: Deferred care reorders the wage calculation
findings.claim: The later disclosure changes the apparent wage calculation into a deferred-care relation: payment would be intelligible, but the repair is directed toward protecting orphan property rather than serving the refusing town.
findings.mechanism: The focus wage and taking carriers at 18:77:24:1 and 18:77:22:2 meet the 18:82 disclosure and wider orphan and barrier contexts. Their contact changes the act from a lost immediate fee into guarded value whose beneficiary appears later.
findings.reader_payoff: The tension shifts from whether labor deserved compensation to when compensation, custody, and benefit are legitimately assigned.
findings.containment: The reading preserves the village's failure and does not assert a single physical account of the wall. The capture branch is contrastive and qualified, not a claim of literal theft in the focus clause.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective support and HFT later-disclosure support are legacy-unbound; registered focus branches and exact context targets make the relation traceable but not fully lexical.
